name: BSP_UnitInstance_RaiseTurnAssistLoad
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet unit_command_producers, read-only analysis. LISTING ONLY: no Ghidra function covers this address; 009D4E30's body ends at 009D4E95 and the enclosing-candidate heuristic mis-attributes it. Body 009D4FB0-009D4FCE inclusive, void __thiscall(unit, float request), RET 4: fld [ecx+102Ch]; fld [esp+4]; fcomip st,st(1); fstp st(0); jbe 009D4FCE; movss xmm0,[esp+4]; movss [ecx+102Ch],xmm0.
